**No merged PRs can be identified with the tools in this session, so I can't answer the "which PRs and when merged" part.** The evidence below establishes the function and its current body at the pinned head, which is what any qualifying PR would have had to change.

**What I could establish**

1. The submit handler is `handleFormSubmission`, an `async` arrow function at `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.component.tsx:305-360`. It runs the future-revision check (lines 311-327), builds `newBasketItem` (lines 329-353), and calls `onSave` in a try/catch (lines 355-359). It is wired to the form at line 481 via `handleSubmit(handleFormSubmission, handleFormSubmissionError)`.
2. The only other `handleFormSubmission` symbols in the repo are in `esm-form-entry-app` (`fe-wrapper.component.ts`, a private method) and `esm-patient-task-list-app` (`add-task-form.component.tsx`). Neither is the medications drug order form.
3. Falkon has one repository for this, `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart`, default branch `main`. I read the file at the default ref, which I take to be the pinned head.

**What blocks the PR question**

- My tools here are grep, glob, read_file, list_tree, list_repos, and the two symbol-lookup tools. None of them lists commits, lists PRs, or returns diffs. Falkon's instructions mention `list_commits`, `get_diff`, and `list_branches`, but those are not available to me in this session.
- The local checkout is not a git repository (no `.git` directory), so there is no local history to fall back on.

**What would settle it:** run `list_commits` on `packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.component.tsx` for `main` since 2026-04-16, then `get_diff` on each commit. Keep only commits whose hunks fall inside lines 305-360 of the function as it stands at head, and map each to its merged PR and merge date. Any commit with hunks in other parts of the file gets excluded. With those tools enabled I can do that.

  {"path": "packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.component.tsx", "startLine": 305, "endLine": 360},
